# Coffee polyphenols improve peripheral endothelial function after glucose loading in healthy male adults.

@article{Ochiai2014CoffeePI, title={Coffee polyphenols improve peripheral endothelial function after glucose loading in healthy male adults.}, author={Ryuji Ochiai and Yoko Sugiura and Yasushi Shioya and Kazuhiro Otsuka and Yoshihisa Katsuragi and Teruto Hashiguchi}, journal={Nutrition research}, year={2014}, volume={34 2}, pages={ 155-9 }, url={https://api.semanticscholar.org/CorpusID:207278042} }

It is suggested that a single ingestion of CPP improves peripheral endothelial function after glucose loading in healthy subjects, and the difference between treatments was statistically significant.
